{{Top|leg}}
'''Chiss long-range shuttles''' were [[Transport/Legends|transport]] vehicles, each equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], used by the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. These [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] were considered to be small, but could easily carry a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], two [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] and four [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].
